items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I played with him at North Carolina A&T, in the band.

ctx.x: Yes, I do. I was at the Club Baron one night, and this guy, Arthur Merriweather... I played with him at North Carolina A&T, in the band. He was a great trumpet player. We had a jazz orchestra and everything. What happened, they caught me playing in the band room some Benny Goodman solos, and they took away my privileges. So I didn’t have anywhere to practice.
